verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents exporting the complete cap table or the full transaction history to Excel or CSV. The only documented exports are adjacent features: an ASC 718 expense report generated as .xlsx and exported scenario models. Neither covers the core ownership ledger or the transaction history the story asks for. A vague 'Standard reporting' line on the pricing page does not establish open-format cap table export.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can export my complete cap table and full transaction history to open formats (Excel/CSV) at any time — my ownership data is never held hostage
